trailhead.label: On the Völsegger Weg below the Ansitz Velseck, Tiers

cautions: The Promenadenweg has rooty, stony stretches in the forest: watch your dog’s footing.
The last 450 m are on the gravel lane to the Ansitz Velseck and the Völsegger Weg, where guests’ cars come and go: keep your dog on a short lead.
One crossing of the Völsegger Weg in the middle of the loop.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.On the Völsegger Weg below the Ansitz Ve: Sulla Via Völsegg sotto la residenza Velseck, Tires
textIt.The Promenadenweg has rooty, stony stret: Il Promenadenweg ha tratti con radici e sassi nel bosco: fai attenzione a dove mette le zampe il cane.
textIt.The last 450 m are on the gravel lane to: Gli ultimi 450 m sono sulla stradina sterrata della residenza Velseck e sulla Via Völsegg, dove passano le auto degli ospiti: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.One crossing of the Völsegger Weg in the: Un attraversamento della Via Völsegg a metà anello.
